question: True or false: take two identical sheets of grid paper, crumple one into a ball and drop it onto the flat one (keeping it within the edges) — at least one point of the crumpled sheet must end up lying exactly above its matching point on the flat sheet.
anchorText: at least one point of the crumpled sheet that lies directly above its corresponding point

question: True or false: no matter how the two slices of bread and the slice of ham are flung around a room, a single straight flat cut can always slice all three of them exactly in half at once.
anchorText: This is possible even if the objects overlap

question: Firefighters sometimes smother a chemical fire with sand. If you poured sand onto burning chlorine trifluoride, what would happen?
choices: The sand would smother the flames
anchorText: It ignites sand, asbestos, glass, and even ashes of substances that have already burned in oxygen

question: Because of its extreme (~98°) axial tilt, each pole of the planet Uranus experiences roughly:
choices: A 17-hour cycle of day and night, like a fast Earth
Six months of daylight, then six months of darkness
About 42 years of daylight, then about 42 years of night
A perpetual dim twilight across the whole planet
anchorText: its poles get around 42 years of continuous sunlight, followed by 42 years of continuous darkness
